title: ZEN's Upgraded Netherite
description: Expand Netherite progression with new rare alloys, advanced upgrades, unique abilities, and a deeper endgame experience.
body:
💎 ZEN's Upgraded Netherite


A deeper Netherite progression system built around rare alloys, powerful upgrades, socketed runes, and endgame equipment.

ZEN's Upgraded Netherite is a NeoForge mod for Minecraft that expands the vanilla Netherite endgame with a complete alloy-based progression system.

Instead of stopping at vanilla Netherite, players can mine new rare ores, craft advanced alloys, upgrade their equipment through multiple tiers, and customize armor with powerful runes.

The mod is designed as a vanilla-friendly late-game expansion for players who want Netherite to become the beginning of a deeper progression path, not the end of it.


🔥 At a Glance


Multiple new Netherite-based alloys

New rare ores and gemstones

Advanced gear progression beyond vanilla Netherite

Full armor, tools, weapons, and elytra sets for each alloy

Socketable rune system with 5 tiers per rune

Netherite Anvil for advanced upgrades

Singularite equipment as the ultimate endgame tier

Divine Singularite armor with full-set flight

Powerful late-game items such as Netherite Apples, Void Totem, Graviton, Black Hole, and White Hole

Vanilla-friendly survival progression

Designed for players who want a meaningful reason to keep mining, upgrading, and exploring after Netherite


🧠 How It Works


The mod adds a new progression path after Netherite.

Players mine rare ores, turn them into gemstone blocks, and combine them with Netherite-based alloys to create stronger upgrade tiers.

Each alloy builds on the previous one, creating a long and rewarding upgrade chain from Netherite all the way to Singularite.

Equipment can then be improved even further with runes. Runes are special upgrade items that can be socketed into armor using the Netherite Anvil. Each rune has 5 tiers, with stronger tiers unlocking better effects.

The ultimate goal is Singularite gear, an extremely powerful and unbreakable endgame equipment tier. Singularite armor can also be upgraded with a Graviton to create mysterious Divine armor.

Wearing the full Divine Singularite armor set grants flight.


⚔️ Core Features


📌 Expanded Netherite Progression


Continue progressing after vanilla Netherite with several advanced alloys and upgrade tiers.

Each alloy requires the previous tier, making progression feel gradual, expensive, and rewarding.


⛏️ New Rare Ores


Discover new rare resources in the Overworld:

Topaz

Fluorite

Amber

Ruby

Sapphire

Onyx


These ores are used to craft alloy materials and push your gear beyond Netherite.


🧱 Alloy Progression


Upgrade your equipment through multiple advanced materials:

Emeraldite

Topazite

Fluorisite

Amberite

Rubycite

Sapphenite

Onyxerite

Singularite


Each tier brings you closer to the final endgame equipment.


🛡️ Full Equipment Sets


Each alloy includes:

Sword

Pickaxe

Axe

Shovel

Hoe

Helmet

Chestplate

Leggings

Boots

Elytra


Singularite equipment is unbreakable, making it the ultimate long-term gear goal.


🔮 Rune System


Runes are powerful armor upgrades with 5 tiers each.

Available runes:

Rune of Vitality

Telluric Rune

Ember Rune

Abyssal Rune


Runes can grant effects related to health, luck, mining, fall protection, fire survival, lava movement, water exploration, underwater mining, and more.

Tier I runes can be found in End City loot, while higher tiers are crafted by upgrading the previous rune tier.


🧰 Netherite Anvil


The Netherite Anvil is an advanced and unbreakable anvil used for special modded upgrades.

It is required to:

Socket runes onto armor

Apply certain modded upgrades

Create Divine Singularite armor using Gravitons


This gives high-end upgrades their own dedicated progression station.


🌀 Singularite


Singularite is the final alloy tier of the mod.

It creates unbreakable tools, weapons, armor, and elytra.

It is expensive, powerful, and designed as a true endgame material.


❔ Divine Singularite Armor


Singularite armor can be upgraded with a Graviton to create Divine armor.

Divine armor pieces appear as mysterious “???” items.

When the full Divine Singularite armor set is worn, the player gains the ability to fly.

Flight only works with the complete Divine set.


🔨 Singularite Hammer


The Singularite Hammer is a special endgame mining tool.

It mines in a true 3x3 area, applies enchantments such as Fortune and Silk Touch correctly, and is designed for fast large-scale mining.

It is unbreakable and enchants like a pickaxe.


🍎 Special Items


The mod also adds several powerful late-game items:

Netherite Apple

Enchanted Netherite Apple

Netherite Stick

Netherite Shield

Netherite Elytra

Netherite Pearl

Netherite Totem

Void Totem

Black Hole

White Hole

Graviton

Netherite Anvil


These items expand late-game survival with new utility, protection, crafting goals, and progression milestones.


🎯 Why Use It


Perfect if you want:

A longer Netherite progression

A stronger late-game survival experience

Rare ores with real crafting value

Expensive but rewarding upgrades

Rune-based armor customization

A reason to keep exploring after Netherite

Endgame tools that feel powerful and unique

A vanilla-friendly expansion that does not replace Minecraft’s identity

A progression system that feels earned instead of instantly overpowered
